subject: general
question:
Consider the following statements regarding Infrastructure and Urban Development in the ***Union Budget 2025-26***:

 
• The Urban Challenge Fund has been allocated ₹1 lakh crore to modernize cities and transform them into growth hubs.
 
• The Modified UDAN Scheme aims to enhance regional air connectivity to 120 new destinations.

Which of the statements given above is/are ***correct***?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both Statements 1 and 2.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Union Budget 2025-26 has allocated ₹1 lakh crore to the Urban Challenge Fund for city modernization.**
 
• **The Modified UDAN Scheme is introduced to boost regional air connectivity with 120 new destinations.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The ₹1 lakh crore **Urban Challenge Fund** will help transform cities into growth hubs by improving infrastructure and planning.
 
• The **Modified UDAN Scheme** is expanding regional air connectivity, adding 120 new destinations.
 
• The government also allocated **₹15,000 crore SWAMIH Fund** to complete 1 lakh stressed housing units.
 
• The focus is on **affordable housing, smart cities, and urban mobility** for sustainable urban development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Urban Challenge Fund**__

 __
 
• Aimed at improving urban infrastructure, public transport, and smart city initiatives.
 
• Focuses on urban sustainability and economic growth.
 
 
 
• **Modified UDAN Scheme**__
 __
 
• Expands air connectivity to underserved and unserved regions.
 
• Enhances affordability and accessibility of air travel for citizens.
 
 
 
• **SWAMIH Fund**__
 __
 
• A government-backed fund to complete stalled housing projects.
 
• Ensures homebuyers receive delayed housing units.
 
 
 
• **Other Key Infrastructure Allocations**__
 
 
• Expansion of metro rail and smart mobility solutions.
 
• Increased investment in affordable housing and rental housing schemes.
 
 

43:T
